card.text: Explore Rosalind, an inner moon of Uranus, through its measured shape.

introduction.text: Rosalind is a small inner moon of Uranus discovered by Voyager 2. Its measured outline is consistent with a nearly spherical body.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: A published 72 km spherical shape estimate. The grid marks missing imagery; local terrain is unresolved.
